concerns.text: T004 says 'n_estimators grid' with no values; plan.md Phase 3.2 has the literal placeholder 'n_estimators=[[deferred]]'. The grid search is not executable deterministically — an implementer cannot run or verify a grid whose values are undefined. Specify concrete values (e.g., n_estimators=[100,200,400]).

T005 sources elemental CTE from 'MP pure-element entries (e.g., mp-112 for Zr)', but SC-001 mandates the NIST Thermophysical Properties database. The task as written produces a baseline that fails its own success criterion; the verification ('improvement over baseline R² is reported') cannot confirm SC-001 compliance. Align the source (amend SC-001 or switch the task to NIST).

T003's VIF fallback is 'PCA retaining components explaining ≥ 95 % variance with a Ridge model on the components', but FR-008 specifies 'PCA retaining the first two components' used directly as predictors. The task adds a Ridge model and a different component rule the spec never authorized; an implementer following T003 will violate FR-008.

T007 uses 'standardized coefficients' for linear-regression importance, but SC-003's primary clause mandates 'SHAP values for linear regression' (standardized coefficients appear only as a secondary note). Three artifacts state three different methods (SHAP / absolute coefficients / standardized). Pick one and align spec, plan, and task so the verification ('ranked, finite values') is well-defined.

T006 skips the permutation test when N < 50, recording {"permutation_status": "skipped_low_n"}. FR-005 requires ≥ 1000 iterations unconditionally and the spec authorizes no N<50 skip. As written, the task's verification ('p-value or documented null-result flag for every model') can pass while FR-005 is violated. Justify the threshold in the spec or remove the skip.

SC-005's ≥ 95 % ingestion-completeness ratio (entries returned after filtering vs. successfully collected) is never computed or checked: T002's verification covers schema validity and missing values only, and no other task computes the ratio. Add an explicit completeness-ratio computation and check to T002's deliverables/verification.

The FeatureImportance entity defines a per-row 'spearman_rho' field, but T007's feature_importance.csv column list is 'model_type, feature_name, importance_score, rank, pearson_corr, abs_corr_rank' — omitting it. The produced artifact will not match the declared data model; either add the column or update the data model.

T008's verification requires sensitivity_analysis.json and computational_efficiency.json to be 'schema-valid', but no contract schema exists for either artifact (contracts/ contains only mg_dataset, model_metrics, model_output). Name the schema files to be created or drop the schema-validity claim.

T001 offers 'code/quickstart.md (or docs/quickstart.md)' — the ambiguous path means T012's handoff documentation ('document the paper-stage handoff in docs/quickstart.md') may point at a different file than the one created. Pick one path.
